description: Per-session unattended flag (agov-inbox-04). ROUTING ONLY: it changes where an approval ask is delivered, never what the agent may do. agent_unattended_sessions is MUTABLE state (an operator turns it on and off); the audit of who flipped it lives in the append-only hook_events trail. Also adds agent_cron_jobs.unattended, because a cron job has no console at all.
author: icdev-builder
